authorization: User explicitly requested training and checking the revised reward.
scope: v6 CPU fixed-cargo H21 simulation pilot, not GPU or operational confirmation
single_axis: Frozen potential difference added to unchanged terminal cost PPO reward

calibration.service_weights: Mean realized service duration by flow, calibration only
calibration.capacity_fraction: By crane role: productive occupied seconds / (productive occupied seconds + idle seconds with ready useful queue); clipped to [0.1, 1]
calibration.safe_fraction: M/G/1 illustrative inversion with measured mean and CV, assumed mean queue budget 300 seconds; provisional until independent queue validation
calibration.limitation: No universal optimal utilization, no artificial load reductions, no dropping incomplete work

pilot.eta_reason: First fixed diagnostic magnitude in normalized reward units; not selected on evaluation performance
pilot.policy_initialization: same training seed and initial weights in each pair
pilot.action_sampling: stochastic for both training and frozen evaluation
pilot.rule_reference: KEEP + SF_SPT on each evaluation seed
pilot.ppo: PPOConfig defaults, gamma=0.999, cost scale=1000000, 60 intervals per update
pilot.pairing: each training seed maps to one distinct evaluation seed in list order
pilot.selection: last checkpoint only; no best-checkpoint selection or post-result retuning
pilot.success: all three paired held-out terminal costs decrease; original-request cost sensitivity does not worsen; no increased unfinished trucks or vessel work; invariant/admission guards pass
pilot.statistical_scope: Three pairs are a diagnostic pilot and cannot establish a narrow confidence interval or deployment readiness
pilot.early_stop: Only engineering smoke failure, nonfinite optimizer, lost workload, violated physical invariants, or unavailable system resources. Performance does not trigger sample removal.

deferral_audit: Original public requested gate time, NOT notice time. Report actual gate turnaround and original-request-to-exit separately, including requests deferred past measurement end. Sensitivity cost is a proxy, not a verified driver idle-money tariff.
workload_adapter: All 42 full-span H21 cranes; queued jobs split once by fixed capacities, running job belongs to its executing crane. Previously committed one-shot assignments count as fixed. No future realized events enter potential.
legacy_gate: YR-153 August gate refers to pre-v6 evidence; its failed revalidation is retained, not relabelled PASS. This explicitly requested pilot gets fresh input/physical/provenance checks and cannot adopt a policy while confirmation gates remain unmet.
